name: get_organization
title: Read organization
description: Read the organization selected by verified server-side access context.

name: list_memberships
title: List customer memberships
description: List memberships in the verified organization; role checks are enforced by the future service.

name: grant_membership
title: Grant customer membership
description: Grant a customer role to a recipient user. This cannot grant founder access.

name: list_version_approvals
title: List version-bound approvals
description: List approval records allowed by the verified actor and customer visibility policy.

name: request_version_approval
title: Request version-bound approval
description: Request publication or customer review of one exact version. The server assigns requester and state.

name: decide_version_approval
title: Decide version-bound approval
description: A permitted human approves or rejects the exact requested version; the service checks role, expiry and current version.
